status: PROVISIONAL G1 thickness-recovery study (design/mechanical/G1_BRIEF.md section 4). Authored definitions only: every total, sizing, check and credibility verdict is computed by tools/g1_scenarios.py from these definitions, inputs/stack_parameters.json (via mech_model.eval_stack) and generated/main_height_map.json. Nothing here is a supplier dimension.
credibility_rule: nominal T_total <= target upper (15.5) AND RSS T_total <= target upper; the linear worst case is reported, not required
every lever in the scenario has status CREDIBLE_LATER_TASK (a later electrical / placement / G2 task inside existing authority, no unavailable supplier, RF or owner evidence)
the cover option is sized by the 5 ATM plate check (status PASS or PASS_NOMINAL) and its air gap check passes; a laminated (OCA) option is not computable today
no deterministic scenario check fails (FPC under-run in the lower web, U8 geometric feasibility)

no lever uses a best-case supplier value: heights come from package_heights.json max + solder allowance (+ high-CV allowance), never from nominal or minimum supplier values; h_pod is not a lever because T_total does not depend on it

tolerance_policy.note: Design choices are fixed per scenario at their scenario value; tolerance terms are then stacked: linear = every term at +delta simultaneously (evaluated through the stack rules), RSS = nominal + sqrt(sum of squared single-term sensitivities).

electrical_evidence.rail_source: 09_STORAGE.kicad_sch sheet notes (read-only): 'VCC = VOUT2_3V0_PROVISIONAL. Kingston allows 2.7-3.6 V', 'VCCQ = VOUT1_1V8', 'C901/C902: VCC 4.7uF + 220nF. C903/C904: VCCQ 2.2uF + 100nF'
electrical_evidence.voltage_rating: no voltage-rating property on C901/C903 in the schematic or BOM (no MPN); a later task must select the rating
electrical_evidence.assessment: 0402 MLCC in 4.7 uF and 2.2 uF exist as a class (no MPN invented). At 3.0 V a 6.3 V-class 0402 4.7 uF part loses a large share of its capacitance to DC bias; the effective capacitance must be checked against eMMC VCC guidance and, if short, C901 split into two 0402 parts (same height) or C902/C901 re-balanced. C903 at 1.8 V has less derating. Electrically valid in principle; requires the later MAIN BOM/placement task. G1 changes no schematic or footprint.

plate_check.method: Linear small-deflection Kirchhoff plate, circular, uniform pressure p (Roark / Timoshenko closed forms): D = E t^3 / (12 (1 - nu^2)); clamped edge: w = p a^4 / (64 D), sigma = 3 p a^2 / (4 t^2); simply supported edge: w = (5 + nu) p a^4 / (64 (1 + nu) D), sigma = 3 (3 + nu) p a^2 / (8 t^2). A PSA / adhesive ring on a ledge lets the edge rotate, so simply supported is the sizing case; clamped is the optimistic bound. Flagged beyond small-deflection validity when w / t > 0.5 (membrane stiffening then makes the linear result conservative).
plate_check.corners: nominal = p nom, a nom, nu nom, E nom, sigma_allow nom; conservative = p max, a max, nu max, E min, sigma_allow min
plate_check.status_rule: PASS = simply supported passes at the conservative corner; PASS_NOMINAL = passes at nominal only; FAIL = fails at nominal

p_test_MPa.source: OD-WATER 2026-10-11: 5 ATM read as 5 bar static overpressure; max = 1.25 x assumed qualification margin. The test standard and its margin are not in the repository (qualification item ATM-Q1).

a_cover_mm.source: Free span radius of the cover = inner edge of its bond ledge; the ledge lies outside the display (R_display 21.95 + >= 0.2 assembly clearance) so the display can approach the cover; max = MAIN radius 23.0 (case G3).

w_cover_land_mm.source: Cover bond / seal land width beyond a (PSA or adhesive ring for 5 ATM); SR-COVER-LENS.

t_bezel_min_mm.source: Minimum case bezel wall outside the cover edge (case G3).

plate_check.c_gap_note: PARAMETRIC: minimum residual air gap between the deflected cover and the display at the test pressure
plate_check.a_window_note: PARAMETRIC: window bond / frame overlap subtracted from the double-sided REAR envelope radius to get the unsupported window radius (barrier walls are not counted as supports: they must not carry the pressure load, X20)

sapphire.source: generic single-crystal sapphire class (orientation-dependent modulus); sigma_allow = planning design allowable at the test pressure (flexural strength class divided by a safety factor), not a supplier value; SR-COVER-LENS

cs_glass.source: generic chemically strengthened aluminosilicate glass class; planning allowable, not a supplier value; SR-COVER-LENS

pc.source: generic optical polycarbonate class (window option only); planning allowable incl. creep, not a supplier value

w_caseback_seal_mm.source: Radial band for a caseback face / radial seal at the case inner wall at REAR level (O-ring or flat gasket groove + land; G3).
